name: mess3_m1m2_linear
note: Standard (linear) reward variant of mess3_m1m2: the reward is the payoff of a state drawn from the full posterior if that state lies in the chosen offer, else 0, so the value is the payoff mass m(X), linear in the posterior. beta = 12 matches the target policy's mean entropy to that of mess3_m1m2. Everything else identical.
